source: The advice term of the network leak bound as registered caps, not honest traces' lengths. The bound counts the advices the registered codec admits: at most 2^c strings are charged c bits or fewer (Kraft; the premise hAs of EncardAccSeqsSampledLe, Security/Definitions/NetworkCertifier/Guarantees/SampledCharge.lean), and the codec and its cap are registered before the first window, with advice over the cap refused (certifier PROTOCOL.md, A7; the compile slice proves each window's charge at most c_w). An adversarial prover picks any advice up to c_w, so each line is c_w times the scope's 600 s machine-windows, i.e. the cap a request times the scope's requests. code_v1's lengths are data-dependent (an adaptive arithmetic code: KT estimates over the decisions' runs with counts carried across windows from the book's priors, Exp-Golomb-binned counts and values, self-delimiting segments), so the card charges the cap, never the mean. An honest window above its cap is refused (completeness, not soundness); each line's source gives the condition under which honest windows fit and the share of traced windows that exceed it. Traced windows are 60 s and hold at most 1,000 requests, so each is scaled to a 600 s window by its bits a request; a 600 s window averages ten of them. Regime (a), batch-invariant Definitions, charges 0 bits and has no line on a log axis. A cap of 8 bits a request (c_w = 67,232 bits), which honest windows fit at any load without KV pressure (at most 5.98) and every small-KV window with arrivals exceeds (14.3-30.3; 10 of 32 traced windows (31%)), has no line: it sits a factor 2.7 above the 3-bit line. Not measured on GLM-5.3: the charges are vLLM d9105ea80's scheduler serving Llama-3.2-1B and Llama-3.1-8B on the RTX PRO 6000 (MRV2), carried over. This card supersedes art:f09f588b6442ef251890e7157398f1668e52a21f09e409b05f293534c4767a24, whose 0.008 and 0.33 bit/request lines were ENC-REPLAY's residual under egress-tell contexts, which the registered codec does not have: under code_v1 they exceed 31 of 32 traced windows (97%) and 30 of 32 traced windows (94%), and its 2.2 and 5.5k lines 23 of 32 traced windows (72%) and 19 of 49 traced windows (39%). Requests: figure1.scopes at cursor/proofs-spotfig-8216 93eea67d14 on the GLM-5.3 workload card, 4,500 tokens a request at 4.52e+14 FLOP, MFU 0.4 on the H200's dense FP8 peak: 2.07e+16 requests a world-year and 5.522e+12 a datacenter-year (100,000 GPUs), 8,404 requests a 600 s machine-window. Advice v1's table: art:0f5f23d498a7f042fcf2a638d9a1500afbc916a4498569666957754415428c30; v0's per-window bits: art:468c033980f026bd79f515b8dd6d7be9f7bcccef002e5de254185870571d6fa3, art:7b475cd238ad9f008c8a70937e06036bf98848559a45474a069e54276b8c0772, art:cddd5efa658f1f0fa6bfd40d94865b1dc8bde8cda3208a70a1e45d50af9b3033.

lines.label: Advice cap 0.1 bit/req (sync, saturated, in order)
lines.source: A registered cap of 0.1 bits a request, c_w = 840 bits a 600 s window of 8,404 GLM-5.3 requests; the line is c_w times the scope's windows, the most any accepted advice is charged. Honest windows fit only with the synchronous scheduler, a waiting queue at every step, admission in the certified release order (no order entries), and no prefix-cache hits or KV pressure: seeded heavy, 0.074. Greedy heavy is 0.074 without its 47 order entries and 0.62 with them. Exceeding it: 30 of 32 traced windows (94%) of code_v1 (Advice v1, held-out book: each trace's book fit on the other 15), 32 windows of 60 s over 16 Llama-3.2-1B traces, a window with arrivals by its bits a request, one without held to c_w.

lines.label: Advice cap 3 bits/req (saturated)
lines.source: A registered cap of 3 bits a request, c_w = 25,212 bits a 600 s window of 8,404 GLM-5.3 requests; the line is c_w times the scope's windows, the most any accepted advice is charged. Honest windows fit when the engine is saturated, sync or async, with admission off the release order: every heavy window (0.074-2.39, the most async heavy behind the network certifier, its release order certified) and chunked prefill (1.98-2.08). Medium (3.30-3.42), light (3.41-5.98) and every small-KV window with arrivals exceed it. Exceeding it: 22 of 32 traced windows (69%) of code_v1 (Advice v1, held-out book: each trace's book fit on the other 15), 32 windows of 60 s over 16 Llama-3.2-1B traces, a window with arrivals by its bits a request, one without held to c_w.

lines.label: Advice cap 40 bits/req (every traced window)
lines.source: A registered cap of 40 bits a request, c_w = 336,160 bits a 600 s window of 8,404 GLM-5.3 requests; the line is c_w times the scope's windows, the most any accepted advice is charged. Every traced window fits, the small-KV ones included (at most 30.3, 315 preemptions at 8,192 KV tokens). Exceeding it: 0 of 32 traced windows (0%) of code_v1 (Advice v1, held-out book: each trace's book fit on the other 15), 32 windows of 60 s over 16 Llama-3.2-1B traces, a window with arrivals by its bits a request, one without held to c_w.

lines.label: Advice cap 8 kbit/req (raw schedule)
lines.source: A registered cap of 8000 bits a request, c_w = 67,232,000 bits a 600 s window of 8,404 GLM-5.3 requests; the line is c_w times the scope's windows, the most any accepted advice is charged. The raw schedule charged as is, without the scheduler replayed in the circuit: v0 step records are 5.18-5.86 kbit a request per trace; the window over the cap is seeded light's tail (47 arrivals), and 3 of 49 (6%) exceed it on I1 v0 bits, an upper bound on the step records. Exceeding it: 1 of 49 traced windows (2%) of v0 step records, 49 windows of 60 s over 19 Llama-3.2-1B and Llama-3.1-8B traces, each window's step records estimated as its I1 v0 bits times its trace's step-record share (80-84%), a window with arrivals by its bits a request, one without held to c_w.
